title: Align live traversal with node-component ids from existing events
narrative: As a run proceeds, Fangore’s console lights interiors that were laid out ahead of time. Inference and tool events must map to the same node-component identities under a parent graph node so the path lights up without a second observability graph. Complements `fangore_node_components` and `nubble_insp_rollout_graph`.[^june-nc-trav]
implementation: `mechaharness.node_component.traversal_from_events` projects EventLog payloads whose types are existing core events (`inference`, `tool_call`, `tool_result`, `turn_start`, …) into `TraversalRecord` rows with `parent_node_id` and component ids. Harness emits enrich those payloads with `parent_node_id` / `component_id` / `execution_node_id`.
validation: Harness `graph_recipes` op `traversal_contract` → `_run_traversal_contract`. Soft expects: inference and tool_call records present; parents non-empty. Unit: `tests/test_node_component.py`.
